senses.gloss: or אוֹלָרְיִין m. pl. (pl. of aularis or aularius = aulicus, D. C. Lat.) belonging to the royal court, court-, only in connect. with כלים or בגדים.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 114a">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>בגדי הא׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>כלים האוליירין</he>); <cite ref="Niddah 20a:33">Nidd. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>כלים האולרין</he> court clothes, including white cloaks <he>(גלימי</he>), and red home or table dresses (<he>לבושי</he>, <he>פתורי</he>); v. Luebk. Alterth. s. v. Kleidung; Becker Gallus, ed. Gœll I, 16. Cmp. <cite ref="H00806"><he>חִימּוּצָתָא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="B00347"><he>בּוּרְדִּיקָא</he></cite>.
